# bintables/program

> Program skeleton: entry point, top-level code, functions, support code and data.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/program.pkg)

Rendered once per program. The compiler fills these placeholders:

| placeholder | contents |
|---|---|
| `{main}` | the top-level statements |
| `{frame}` | stack space for top-level variables |
| `{functions}` | every `fn` |
| `{support}` | `support` sections of the packages used |
| `{data}` | `data` sections, e.g. string literals |

`_start` calls the top-level code as a function (`__pk_entry`), then passes
its result to the `exit` system call, so a top-level `return` sets the exit
code.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
bits 64
default rel
global _start
section .text
_start:
call __pk_entry
mov rdi, rax
mov rax, 60
syscall
__pk_entry:
push rbp
mov rbp, rsp
sub rsp, {frame}
{main}
xor eax, eax
leave
ret
{functions}
{support}
section .data
{data}
```
